items.Title: Senior Staff/ Principal DevOps Engineer
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Fanatics Collectibles is seeking a Senior Staff / Principal Infrastructure Engineer to provide technical leadership and own the infrastructure strategy supporting the Topps China WeChat e-commerce platform.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant autonomy, influence and business-critical responsibility. You will act as the principal technical authority for China-based infrastructure, defining its architecture, operational standards and long-term roadmap.

Due to data-residency and access requirements under China's Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL), certain systems and user data must remain within China and cannot be directly accessed by our US-based engineering teams. You will provide the essential in-country technical presence required to operate these environments securely and compliantly.

You will oversee infrastructure operated by key technology partners—including XCXD, supporting the WeChat Mini-Program, and Baozun, supporting order management and fulfilment—while ensuring that all systems meet Fanatics' expectations for scalability, reliability, security and performance.

This is not a traditional operational DevOps role. You will set technical direction, challenge architecture decisions, govern vendor delivery and establish a resilient infrastructure model capable of supporting the continued growth of Fanatics Collectibles in China.
